commands.step: Packaging gate (LICENSE/README in every publishable tarball)

commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
for dir in packages/* templates/*; do
  [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] || continue
  priv=$(node -p "require('./$dir/package.json').private === true")
  [ "$priv" = "true" ] && { echo "skip private $dir"; continue; }
  name=$(node -p "require('./$dir/package.json').name")
  echo "::group::dry-run $name"
  npm publish -w "$name" --access public --provenance --dry-run
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

set -euo pipefail
TAG_ARGS=()
if [ "${RELEASE_PRERELEASE:-}" = "true" ]; then
  TAG_ARGS=(--tag next)
  echo "GitHub prerelease: publishing with --tag next (never latest)"
fi
for dir in packages/* templates/*; do
  [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] || continue
  priv=$(node -p "require('./$dir/package.json').private === true")
  [ "$priv" = "true" ] && { echo "skip private $dir"; continue; }
  name=$(node -p "require('./$dir/package.json').name")
  ver=$(node -p "require('./$dir/package.json').version")
  view_out=""
  view_ec=0
  view_out="$(npm view "$name@$ver" version 2>&1)" && view_ec=0 || view_ec=$?
  if [ "$view_ec" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "skip $name@$ver — already on registry"
    continue
  fi
  unpublished=0
  if echo "$view_out" | grep -Eq 'code E404|E404|404 Not Found|is not in this registry|version not found'; then
    unpublished=1
  elif echo "$view_out" | grep -q 'E403' && echo "$view_out" | grep -Eqi 'not found|not in this registry|version not found'; then
    unpublished=1
  fi
  if [ "$unpublished" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "::error::npm view $name@$ver failed with exit $view_ec (not a version-not-found signal) — refusing to publish"
    echo "$view_out"
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ ${#TAG_ARGS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "publish $name@$ver — not on registry (tag next)"
  else
    echo "publish $name@$ver — not on registry"
  fi
  echo "::group::publish $name@$ver"
  npm publish -w "$name" --access public --provenance "${TAG_ARGS[@]}"
  echo "::endgroup::"
done

commands.step: Registry round-trip — npm install CLI from registry
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
ver=$(node -p "require('./packages/cli/package.json').version")
prefix=$(mktemp -d)
echo "installing @ai-rpg-engine/cli@$ver from https://registry.npmjs.org into $prefix"
npm install -g --prefix "$prefix" --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org "@ai-rpg-engine/cli@$ver"
PATH="$prefix/bin:$PATH" ai-rpg-engine --help

set -euo pipefail
docker rmi ai-rpg-engine:ci-smoke || true
while IFS= read -r tag; do
  [ -n "$tag" ] || continue
  docker rmi "$tag" || true
done <<< "$META_TAGS"
primary=$(printf '%s\n' "$META_TAGS" | awk 'NF { print; exit }')
[ -n "$primary" ] || { echo "::error::no GHCR tag from metadata-action"; exit 1; }
docker pull "$primary"
digest=$(docker image inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' "$primary")
docker run --rm "$digest" --help
